🚨 Deep dive | Intel -36.7% since its earnings, AMD only -13.7%!! Same industry, totally different stories 😱🔥

1️⃣ Intel crashed: Q4 guide $15-16B vs ~$17.1B expected, PC weakness to last at least through 1H 2027 (CFO). -28.6% on 30 Oct, its worst day since 1974

2️⃣ AMD held up: revenue $13.38B vs $13.09B expected, Q4 guide ~$17B vs ~$16.2B; data center is now 64% of sales. Lisa Su expects server revenue to double in 2027

3️⃣ Intel bulls vs bears: KeyBanc calls the selloff "quite overdone"; Seaport calls it "kind of dead money". BofA, Roth and Seaport cut it to neutral

4️⃣ AMD bulls vs bears: Stifel ($725) and Goldman ($700) stay bullish; BofA cut its target to $650 on lower sector multiples; client + gaming revenue fell 8%

5️⃣ The key difference: AMD now earns mostly from data centers and outsources chipmaking to TSMC; Intel still leans on PCs and builds its own fabs

📌 Both were hit by the chip selloff: Intel -54% and AMD -25% from their 30-day highs (closes to 4 Nov).
